biography.ja: ヴェネツィアの裕福な紙商人の家に生まれ、経済的に恵まれた立場から公職に就く必要なく作曲活動に専念できた点で、同時代の多くの作曲家とは異なる境遇にあった。存命中に数多くのオペラを発表して人気を博したが、その大半は今日失われている。同郷のヴィヴァルディとはヴェネツィアの楽壇で同時代を生きた存在である。
biography.en: Born into a wealthy Venetian paper-merchant family, he was unusual among composers of his time in being financially independent, free to devote himself to composition without needing to hold an official post. He produced numerous operas that won popularity in his lifetime, though most of them are now lost. He and his fellow Venetian Vivaldi were contemporaries active in the same city's musical life.

style.ja: イタリア・バロックの器楽合奏様式を洗練させ、明快な旋律線と均整の取れた楽章構成を特徴とする協奏曲や合奏曲を数多く残した。オペラ作曲家としても高い人気を誇ったが、現存する作品は器楽曲が中心であり、当時の評価とは対照的に今日では専ら器楽作曲家として記憶されている。
style.en: He refined the instrumental ensemble style of the Italian Baroque, leaving numerous concertos and ensemble works marked by clear melodic lines and well-balanced movement structure. He was also highly popular as an opera composer, but the works that survive are predominantly instrumental, so that, in contrast to his reputation in his own time, he is remembered today almost exclusively as a composer of instrumental music.

impact.ja: 皮肉なことに、今日最も広く知られる「作品」は20世紀の音楽学者が彼の残した断片的な低音主題を元に自由に作曲し直した楽曲であり、本人が実際に書いた旋律部分はごくわずかに過ぎない。この逸話は、作曲家の名声が後世どのように形作られ、時に本人の手を離れて一人歩きするかを示す興味深い事例としてしばしば紹介される。
impact.en: Ironically, the "work" most widely known under his name today was in fact freely composed in the twentieth century by a musicologist working from a fragmentary bass line he had left behind, with only a small portion of the actual melody traceable to him. This episode is often cited as a fascinating example of how a composer's reputation can be shaped by later generations, sometimes taking on a life of its own.
